Лабораторная работа №2 — предметная область «Кулинария»

Дисциплина: ППОИС Выполнил: [ФИО], гр. [группа] Проверил: [ФИО преподавателя]

1. Цель работы

Спроектировать крупный ООП-проект: не менее 50 классов, 150 полей, 100 поведений, 30 ассоциаций, 12 собственных исключений.

2. Достигнуто

  • 108 классов

  • ~250 полей

  • ~180 поведений

  • ~60 ассоциаций

  • 18 исключений

  • 450 тестов, покрытие 96 %

3. Инструменты

Python 3.13, pytest, Sphinx, flake8, GitHub Actions.

4. Базовые типы

Money, Unit, Quantity, Allergen, AllergenSet, Nutrition, NutritionTracker.

Money value object for the culinary domain.

class lab2.src.money.Money(amount_minor: int, currency: str = 'RUB')[source]

Amount of money in a single currency.

Stores an integer number of minor units (kopecks, cents) to avoid floating-point drift.

amount_minor: int
as_major() → float[source]

Return the amount as a float in the major unit.

currency: str = 'RUB'
classmethod from_major(amount: float, currency: str = 'RUB') → Money[source]

Create Money from a value in the major unit (e.g. 12.34 RUB).

is_positive() → bool[source]

Return True if the amount is strictly positive.

is_zero() → bool[source]

Return True if the amount is zero.

Measurement units and conversions for the culinary domain.

An amount together with its measurement unit.

property amount: float

Numeric amount.

GRAM = 'g'

Convert amount from src to dst.

Raises InvalidUnitError if the units belong to different dimensions.

lab2.src.units.is_mass(unit: Unit) → bool[source]

lab2.src.units.is_volume(unit: Unit) → bool[source]

Return (value, base_unit_name) where base is g, ml, or pc.

Allergens and allergen sets used in the culinary domain.

Common food allergens.

GLUTEN = 'gluten'

NUTS = 'nuts'

class lab2.src.allergens.AllergenSet(allergens: Iterable[Allergen] | None = None)[source]

A set of allergens, with helpful membership checks.

add(allergen: Allergen) → None[source]

Add one allergen to the set.

as_set() → set[Allergen][source]

Return a copy of the underlying set.

check_compatibility(restriction: AllergenSet) → None[source]

Raise AllergenConflictError if this set violates restriction.

contains(allergen: Allergen) → bool[source]

Return True if the allergen is present.

intersects(other: AllergenSet) → bool[source]

Return True if the two sets share at least one allergen.

is_empty() → bool[source]

Return True if there are no allergens.

remove(allergen: Allergen) → None[source]

Remove one allergen from the set, if present.

union(other: AllergenSet) → AllergenSet[source]

Return a new set containing both sets’ allergens.

Nutrition values and tracker for the culinary domain.

class lab2.src.nutrition.Nutrition(protein_g: float, fat_g: float, carbs_g: float, fiber_g: float = 0.0)[source]

Nutrition content per 100 g (or 100 ml) of a product.

All values are non-negative. Kilocalories are computed from macros.

CARBS_KCAL_PER_G = 4.0
FAT_KCAL_PER_G = 9.0
PROTEIN_KCAL_PER_G = 4.0
